sources.adaptation: Carry the diagnosis loop and human-in-the-loop reproduction helper unchanged. Atlas Debug conditionally adds the shared Statechart method without modifying the diagnosis procedure.

Statechart entry and supporting tree are unchanged except for an explicit shared-result type in scripts/run.ts, which prevents TypeScript from widening the exit-code union. Runtime behavior is unchanged.

rulings.decision: Diagnosing Bugs owns the reproduction-first diagnosis workflow. Load Statechart when modeled transitions help investigate or understand the bug, or on explicit request. Retain Statechart bounds and real-code replay; a model result does not replace real reproduction or fix verification. No mode chooser or separate explanation procedure is introduced.
